section.div: Open Source framework for voice agents, multimodal apps, and realtime AI. Maintained by Daily and the community.
Simple web to make PDF files from MarkDown. Also allows other capabilities, as LaTex.
Catalog of Cloud dev environments. No accounts, local-first and compatible with AWS, Azure and GCP.
